title: Explicit ordinary native small model
statement: For a scheme Y in universe u and a prime l, use the lifted bounded pro-etale category Site(Y), topology(Y), and inverse postcomposition translation(g) for any scheme automorphism g, as in [lem-sf-weil-frobenius-action-resolutions]. Restrict the actual comparisonRing(l,Y) [lem-sf-adic-section-module-equivalence] to this site. Its translation ring isomorphism is identity on coefficient functions. Compose the equivalence Q [lem-sf-small-site-module-hom] with the inverse of adicSectionModuleEquivalence to obtain the specified additive ordinary equivalence E from small-site modules to native adic modules. These are constructions, with no realization chosen from an existence statement.
